questions.markdown:
Sketch the waveforms for the following signals

a. $x(t)=u(t+1)-2u(t)+u(t-1)$

b. $x(t)=-u(t+3)+2u(t+1)-2u(t-1)+u(t-3)$

Identify whether the following signals are energy signals or power signals. Calculate their energy and power

a. 

$$
x(t)=\begin{cases}1, & -\dfrac{\tau}{2}<t<\dfrac{\tau}{2}\\[4pt]0, & \text{otherwise}\end{cases}
$$

b. $x(t)=u(t)$

Identify if the following signals are periodic. If they are periodic, calculate the fundamental period

a. $x[n]=10\cos\left(\dfrac{7}{15}\pi n\right)$

b. $x[n]=20\cos\left(\dfrac{4\pi}{31}n+\dfrac{\pi}{5}\right)$

Determine the response of the system described by

$$
y[n]=\frac{1}{3}\{x[n+1]+x[n]+x[n-1]\}
$$

to the input signal,

$$
x[n]=\begin{cases}3, & -2\le n\le 2\\[4pt]0, & \text{otherwise}\end{cases}
$$

Determine the step response of the LTI system whose impulse response is

$$
h(t)=u(t-1)-2u(t-2)+u(t-3)
$$

Justify whether the following system is linear, time invariant, causal and memoryless:

$$
y[n]+2y[n-1]=x[n+1].
$$

Use the defining equation for DTFT to evaluate the spectrum of

$$
x[n]=\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^{|n|}.
$$

Sketch the same.

Apply necessary properties to identify the time domain representation of the following frequency domain representation.

$$
X(j\omega)=\left(\frac{e^{j3(\omega-1)}}{1+\dfrac{j(\omega-1)}{2}}\right)
$$
Given $x(t)=\dfrac{d}{dt}\left(3t e^{-3t}u(t)\right)$. Evaluate the Fourier transform of $x(t)$.

Use FT to evaluate the response of the continuous time system having impulse response

$$
h(t)=2\cos(4\pi t)\frac{\sin(\pi t)}{\pi t}
$$

to the input given by $x(t)=0.5+\cos(1.5\pi t)+\cos(3.5\pi t)$

questions.markdown:
Certain discrete time system is described by the difference equation

$$
y[n]-\frac{1}{4}y[n-1]-\frac{1}{8}y[n-2]=x[n]+\frac{3}{4}x[n-1]-\frac{1}{8}x[n-2].
$$

Determine frequency response and impulse response of the system.

The continuous time signal $x(t)=\cos(\omega_0 t)$ is sampled (impulse sampling) with sampling interval $T=0.5\,\text{sec}$. Sketch the spectrum of the sampled signal for $-7\pi\le\omega\le7\pi$ when

(i) $\omega_0=\pi$  
(ii) $\omega_0=2\pi$  
(iii) $\omega_0=3\pi$.

The difference equation of the LTI system is given by:

$$
y[n]=0.5y[n-1]+x[n].
$$

Determine:

(i) system function

(ii) unit impulse response for the stable system

(iii) Sketch the pole-zero plot and indicate the ROC for the system function.

Determine Z-Transform of the signal and indicate the ROC.

$$
x[n]=-n\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)^n u[-n-1] * \left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^{-n} u[-n].
$$

Consider the following transfer function:

$$
H(S)=\frac{S^2+2S-3}{S^2+3S+2}
$$

i) Determine impulse response for the system to be both stable and causal.

ii) Determine inverse system. Does both stable and causal inverse system exist? Justify the answer.
